reason: Approved original CLI-runner discovery. Tony Nicholson’s ZXCC maintains John Elliott’s ZXCC 0.5.7 lineage. The original release and this maintained repository are one project family, not separate records. Canonical root was absent from the fresh 1702-project baseline at ac4ea751fcdb273322cfdac18cd679b83f03a90f and the prior deduplication index. Inspected default-branch head: c45e5065eca63dd045d60511a8b21ab7f567303a. Cross-development tooling executes original binaries with partial CP/M 2/3 API translation. The ED FE trap routes BDOS/BIOS calls to native C; CPMREDIR maps CP/M drives and FCB operations onto host files. Required bios.bin is the bundled tiny ZXCC-specific synthetic BIOS/BDOS shim, with Z80/bios.zsm source, not an original vendor ROM or full CP/M OS. Users separately supply HI-TECH or Digital Research compiler binaries, includes, libraries and overlays. The maintained source derives from John Elliott ZXCC and Ian Collier’s xz80 CPU. Root COPYING/LICENSE and CPU carry GPLv2/GPL-2.0-or-later terms; CPMIO/CPMREDIR contain GNU Library GPL v2-or-later notices. Preserve component terms and separately supplied HI-TECH/Digital Research tools’ licences. README discusses fixes shared with zxccp, yaze and Mark Ogden, but related emulators and compiler repositories are not extra aliases or newly counted runner records here. Wider author, dependency and fork-graph coverage remains partial.
